name: message
title: Message
summary: One message of a conversation with an assistant.
description: One message of a conversation with an assistant. The person's message is a bubble at the end; the assistant's is plain text at the start, with an optional avatar. A header names who wrote it (name, an optional source Chip, the time). Actions sit under it (Copy, Retry, Edit, Good / Bad response), shown on hover and on focus, always on touch; they always take their room, so showing them moves nothing. While streaming it is aria-busy, offers no actions, and shows a shimmering "Thinking…" until its content arrives. Plain text through text, or any content (streaming text, tool chips, a code block, an approval card) as children. chat-composer's threads are made of it.

anatomy.description: A row: the avatar (when there is one) and the main column, 8px apart. aria-busy while streaming. role=user: 56px clear of the start, everything at the end.
The real Avatar (20px, the name's initials or the image), marked data-message="avatar", level with the header
A 20px line, xs: name · source · time. Shown when one of them is given
Medium, ink; cut with an ellipsis and a title when the line is too narrow (free text, not a choice)
The real Chip (neutral), marked data-message="source": where the answer came from; it gives way and is cut before the time
ink-2, tabular; datetime from the datetime prop
The content. role=user: the bubble (field fill, 12px radius, 6px × 12px padding). role=assistant: no box
The text prop: sm, 1.5 line height (1.4 in a bubble), wraps anywhere, keeps line breaks, keeps its own direction; 15px on coarse pointers
Streaming with nothing yet: role=status, a Shimmer "Thinking…"

role=group named "Message actions": ghost xs square muted Buttons (Copy, Retry, Edit) named by their Tooltips, and Toggles (Good response, Bad response; at most one pressed, its thumb filled). Kept inside the message's box (never pulled past its edge). Not rendered while streaming
Visually hidden role=status beside Copy: says Copied while the button is swapped

role.description: user: the person's message, a bubble at the end. assistant: plain text at the start.

name.description: Who wrote it, in the header ("Maya Chen", "Assistant", or a step's label).

avatar.description: Shown beside the header: true for the name's initials, or an image URL (the initials show until it loads).

source.description: Where it came from, as a neutral Chip after the name (a file, a tool, a page).

datetime.description: The time as a machine-readable date, for the <time> element.

text.description: Plain text. For rich content (streaming text, tool chips, a code block) pass children / the default slot instead.

streaming.description: Still being written: aria-busy, no actions, and a shimmering "Thinking…" while there is no content yet.

actions.description: The actions offered, always shown in this order: copy (puts copyText or text on the clipboard, says Copied for 1.5s), retry, edit, good and bad (Good / Bad response, at most one pressed).

copyText.description: What Copy puts on the clipboard; defaults to text (pass it when the content is children).

feedback.description: Good / Bad response, or none (null). While one is chosen the actions stay shown.

labels.description: { actions, copy, copied, retry, edit, good, bad, thinking }: the fixed strings, partial.

slots.default: Rich content instead of text: StreamingText, ToolChips, a CodeBlock, an ApprovalCard

events.action: (action: 'copy' | 'retry' | 'edit' | 'good' | 'bad') an action was pressed (copy after it copied)

a11y.role: article; its actions a group named "Message actions"
keyboard: Tab reaches each action (the row shows at once when focus enters it); Enter / Space press it
Good / Bad response are toggle buttons (aria-pressed)
notes: A thread of messages is the host's: give it role=log so a new message is announced once (chat-composer does).
aria-busy while streaming, so assistive technology waits for the finished text; the Thinking status is role=status.
Every action is icon-only and named (aria-label) by the text its Tooltip shows; Copy announces Copied through a visually hidden status.
Author text keeps its own direction (unicode-bidi: plaintext).

motion: actions: fade in over duration.fast when the pointer is over the message (a real pointer only); at once when focus enters them (kbd-instant); always shown on touch; they keep their room, so nothing moves
copy: the Button's swap (Copy cross-fades into Check)
thinking: the Shimmer's loop (static under reduced motion)
arrival: none of its own; a host thread rises new messages in (chat-composer). Nothing plays on first paint
